2610.04387.title: TrustMed-RL: Long-Horizon Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Diagnosis
2610.04387.paper_summary: Medical language models can produce correct diagnoses despite incomplete investigations and unsupported reasoning. To support long-horizon, evidence-grounded diagnosis, we introduce \textbf{TrustMed-RL}. Built from PubMed rare-disease cases and over 24,000 manually annotated image panels, it integrates interviews, examinations, testing, specialist consultation, and literature search through state-dependent actions. Our 8B vision--language policy, trained with clinically adapted GiGPO and coverage-adjusted diagnostic rewards, achieves 37.1\% diagnostic accuracy on 2,500 evaluation cases, outperforming all evaluated open-weight baselines and improving over supervised fine-tuning by 12.4 percentage points.. When success additionally requires acquiring at least 50\% of supporting test evidence, TrustMed-RL achieves 32.5\%, exceeding GPT-4o by 6.8 percentage points. Furthermore, it surpasses all evaluated baselines on MTMedDialog and multiple larger 27--32B models on AgentClinic. In physician review of 200 diagnostically accepted test-set trajectories, 83.0\% receive evidential-grounding scores of 4--5 out of 5. Physicians' assessments suggest that these diagnostic trajectories are trustworthy and aligned with human diagnostic reasoning.
2610.04387.paper_summary_zh: 醫療語言模型可以在調查不完整和推理不支持的情況下產生正確的診斷。為了支持長期的、基於證據的診斷，我們介紹了\textbf{TrustMed-RL}。該模型基於PubMed的罕見疾病案例和超過24,000個手動標註的影像面板，通過狀態依賴的行動整合了訪談、檢查、測試、專家諮詢和文獻搜索。我們的8B視覺-語言政策，經過臨床適應的GiGPO訓練和調整覆蓋率的診斷獎勵，在2,500個評估案例中達到了37.1\%的診斷準確率，超越了所有評估的開放權重基準，並比監督微調提高了12.4個百分點。當成功還需要獲得至少50\%的支持測試證據時，TrustMed-RL達到了32.5\%，超過了GPT-4o 6.8個百分點。此外，它在MTMedDialog上超越了所有評估的基準，並在AgentClinic上超越了多個更大的27--32B模型。在對200個診斷接受的測試集軌跡的醫生評審中，83.0\%獲得了4--5分（滿分5分）的證據基礎評分。醫生的評估表明這些診斷軌跡是可信的，並且與人類的診斷推理一致。
